source: Hand-written for ISSUE-157: the synthetic streams of an "Other…" command (15 §4.11, 15 §3 row H1). A stdio-raw program speaks no protocol, so each <case>.jsonl holds the plain text lines it writes on stdout (one per line, not JSON), <case>-stderr.jsonl what it writes on stderr, and <case>-timing.jsonl the order of what DwarfAI wrote on its stdin. Raw text has no fields, so the -with-extra variant of a raw stream is the same bytes; the CRLF variants end every line in CRLF (HO-37). The expected files are written by hand from 15 §1.3, §1.4, §4.11 and §6.
